thought: Hard constraints are clean. The biggest soft drivers are consecutive_cost and non_working_days_cost, with significant weekend overages (Patrick/Sara/Nguyen) and some max_total overages (notably Stefaan/Nguyen). Recent block_reassign produced no moves and block_swap/swap often triggered illegal_succession or increased consecutive_cost, so we should try a safer multi-day pattern change that preserves coverage while targeting consecutive/off blocks and potentially weekend patterns.

strategy.reason: Consecutive and days-off penalties dominate; block_swap can exchange multi-day patterns to create valid OFF blocks and break long work stretches while keeping total assignments and coverage more stable than reassign/coverage_fill, and it can also help shift weekend work away from over-weekend nurses if the swapped block includes weekend days.
strategy.avoid: Avoid block_reassign (recently no moves generated) and avoid block_swap constructions that create illegal_succession (seen repeatedly); also avoid coverage_fill since it risks worsening max_total and weekend overages.
